svg.title: File permissions: owner, group and others.
svg.desc: The illustrative -rwxr-x--- mode begins with a normal-file type dash, followed by owner, file group and other permissions. Missing permissions use dashes only within those triplets. Owner, matching group and other categories are alternatives, not added together. Read, write and execute apply to regular files.
svg.text: WHO MAY READ, WRITE OR RUN IT?
ls -l note.txt: example permissions for this existing file.
A group is a set of accounts; each file has an owning group.
Use owner bits if you own it; otherwise group bits if you belong to its group;
otherwise others. These categories are alternatives, not added together.
For files: r = read · w = change contents · x = run.
Within a triplet, - means no permission. The first - identifies a normal file.
